about_the_game:
"Fresh. Local. Kinda illegal."

You play as Rizzo, a raccoon inheriting his grumpy uncle’s veggie burger joint. Deliver burgers by day, explore a mutant-infested sewers by night, and stumble onto a terrifying discovery: meat sells. Especially when it’s human.

Make burgers, feed the town’s growing hunger, and slowly turn your customers into addicts.

They crave it. They need it. They’ll do anything for another bite.

Dive into the sewers, hunt humans, and process your victims into burger-ready supplies to refill your inventory. Keep your dark secret hidden as you carry out your operations. Avoid detection - police will be patrolling the town, and customers must never discover where "tofu" is really coming from.

Serve up your "veggie" burgers and watch the townsfolk's addiction intensify with every delivery. The more they eat, the more they crave. The more they crave, the more they are willing to pay. Your true goal? To make everyone hopelessly addicted to human meat. And remember: no one needs to know what’s really in the burgers.

Fight your way through mutants as you scavenge the sewers looking for humans. Different enemies demand different strategies, and only the right weapons will let you survive the wrong encounter. Not every fight is worth the risk. Dying costs precious time and resources you could use to upgrade your gear and grow your influence.

Features

  • Hunt for Meat - Track down unsuspecting humans, take them out, and process their bodies into fresh burger supplies.

  • Deliver Burgers - Serve up the human meat burgers and watch as the town’s cravings intensify. Watch as your deliveries reshape the town’s appetite… and addiction.

  • Survive the Sewers – Mutants prowl the underground, each more dangerous than the last. Fight when you must, but sometimes running is the only way to live another night.

  • Stay Undercover – Keep your dark secret hidden. Avoid detection while you carry out your operations.

  • Quests, and Secrets - Uncover quests that reveal more about the town, its residents, and your own morally questionable mission.

  • Unlock New Gear & Areas – Unlock new weapons and perks to survive the nights, and new areas that bring new characters, opportunities, and dangers.

  • Day/Night Cycle – Deliver by day under the bright sun, then stalk the shadows at night to refill your inventory.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains content that may not be suitable for all audiences, including:

Stylized cartoon violence – Players can attack enemies and witness cartoonish depictions of dismemberment and the use of corpses as resources.

Drug use – Players may consume fictional substances that temporarily enhance abilities or stats.

Combat – Includes killing mutated or deformed humanoid enemies.
